title: How to clean the drain pump filter
subtitle: Electrolux PerfectCare 700, 9 kg — EW7F7649U2

steps.caption: Clean the drain pump filter
steps.narration: The drain pump filter is behind the bottom-right round hatch.

steps.caption: Unplug and prepare for water
steps.narration: Switch off, unplug, and let any hot water cool before opening. Have a towel and shallow container ready: water may run out.

steps.caption: Open the round hatch
steps.narration: Open the bottom-right hatch to reach the white filter cap.

steps.caption: Lower the blue drain guide
steps.narration: Lower the blue guide, with the container beneath and towel underneath.

steps.caption: Loosen slowly and drain
steps.narration: Turn the filter grip slightly anticlockwise, letting water drain before removal. Tighten it again if you need to empty the container.

steps.caption: Unscrew and remove the filter
steps.narration: When water stops flowing, continue turning anticlockwise and pull the filter out.

steps.caption: Remove debris and rinse
steps.narration: Remove lint and loose objects, then rinse the filter under running water. Wipe the rubber sealing ring and remove visible debris from the opening.

steps.caption: Refit and tighten clockwise
steps.narration: Put the filter back and turn clockwise until firmly seated by hand.

steps.caption: Fold up and close
steps.narration: Fold the blue guide back up, then close the round hatch.

steps.caption: Cleaning complete
steps.narration: Wipe up spills, and check for leaks during the next wash.
